aboutUs.label: About us
aboutUs.prompt: Create an about-us section with an image on one side and a heading, a short paragraph and a button on the other. Let me edit the heading, the text, the button label and link, the image, and pick which side the image sits on.

collectionCarousel.label: Collection carousel
collectionCarousel.prompt: Build a horizontally scrolling product carousel titled 'New arrivals' that pulls its products from a category I choose. Each card shows the product image, name, price and an add-to-cart button, with arrows on both sides and 4 cards visible on desktop, 1.5 on mobile.

promotionalBanner.label: Promotional banner
promotionalBanner.prompt: Create a full-width promotional banner with a background image and a dark overlay, a headline, a short line of text, a discount code and a live countdown timer to a date I set. Let me edit the text, the code, the end date and the overlay strength.

testimonials.label: Testimonials
testimonials.prompt: Create a customer testimonials section: a heading and a 3-column grid of quote cards, each with a star rating, the quote, the customer name and a photo. Make the reviews a repeatable list I can add to, and stack them into one column on mobile.
